notes.title: B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends 3rd Anniversary Sale
notes.notes:
Today marks the third anniversary of B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends launch on Steam! To celebrate we are having a 30% off sale, so if you have been waiting for a chance to pick up the game, this is it!

B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends will always have a special place in our hearts as the first game that Game Grotto published, and as this anniversary comes, we look back on our three years as game developers. Even though we may not be the biggest and most well-known indie game company out there, it has never stopped us from following our dream of making good games that fans of all ages can enjoy. 

Thank you, our fans, for always doing everything you can to support us. And we hope you continue to love the games that we make!

notes.title: B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends 2nd Anniversary
notes.notes:
Today marks the 2nd anniversary of B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends and its release on Steam. Today is a day we remember the milestone that was met when Game Grotto Softworks released their first indie game title. But we also look back and reflect on the lives of those effected by the COVID 19 Pandemic in the year of our release, 2020. 

Two years ago today, the Game Grotto crew was set to attend conventions around the American west coast and share their game with the thousands of gamers. But the reality of COVID 19 made interacting with fans of the game, once a moment of celebration for the hardworking individuals who worked on the team, a distant dream. Even though the Game Grotto team accepted this reality, and the realities of the pandemic, the effects of the pandemic did not stop. Conventions reassured guests that their tickets would be refunded, but when it came to the vendors, they were not so lucky.  The safety of the American people was protected at the cost of businesses run by hard-working individuals. And as quarantines stayed up, the ability to interact with potential fans drifted farther and farther away. Not only did this effect the sales and financial needs of the games production, but it also weighed on the spirits of the ones who created a game they could no longer share.

Today we remember what we lost. not just the lives that departed this world, but the lives of every small business and the dreams that COVID 19 damaged. We reflect on what this pandemic has done and make the decision to keep moving forward, in spite of every obstacle being stacked against us.

Game Grotto Softworks has and always will be an indie game production and development company funded by its co-founder Donovan Gates, a man who sacrifices his livelihood in the hope of bringing a brief escape from the harsh realities of our world to the gamers who need it most. I hope you will choose to support him, and Game Grotto Softworks. We need it now more than ever.

Thank you.
Meagan Gates, Game Grotto Softworks CEO

notes.title: Update to version 1.0.3.
notes.notes:
- Adjustments to several character materials.
- Adjustments to menu screens, backgrounds, and text.
- Arcade mode levels can now progress past level 13.
- Log Book and unlockable entries.
- Arcade mode waves randomized.
- Arcade mode bosses will spawn every 5 levels. 
- 8 additional Arcade Mode levels.
- Responsive menu sound effects.
- Adjustments to menu screens, backgrounds, and text.
- Overhaul to Courtyard level environment.
- Added a new model for Thomas in Courtyard level.
- Fixed Robfriend FAB's decoy, will no longer hurt the player when it takes damage. 
- Reduced all Robofriend's ability cooldowns.
- Added a Robfriend counter to pause menu screen.
- Various minor adjustments.

[h2]Thank you everyone for your patience![/h2]
This will be the last [b]major[/b] update to B.O.T.S. in the Robofriends because we have decided to start a new indie game project. Please look forward to [b]Azyugo: Endless RPG[/b] and follow us on our Discord to stay up to date on development announcements. Thank you for your continued support, whether you are a Twitch subscriber, B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends player, or a family friend of the Game Grotto crew. Every little bit of your support and love really kept the fire burning while we completed this final major update. SO THANK YOU AGAIN!

Donovan, Megan, and the Game Grotto Team.

notes.title: Future Features for B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi there friends![/h1]
Game Grotto is working on several updates and new features for B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends - and we want to get you in the loop. Here are a list of the awesome additions we plan to release in coming months.

[h3]3D Animated cut scenes[/h3]
All of the 2D comic-book style cut scenes will be replaced with 3D animated cut-scenes, giving new life to Story Mode. 

[h3]A hidden unlockable character[/h3]
An unlockable character will be made available. We can't say much more than that for now - because you know [i]spoilers.[/i]

[h3]Four unlockable comic books [/h3]
Progressing through Arcade Mode will unlock comic book pages. These pages feature the Bots and tell their backstories from before the attack on Innovation Robotics. 

[h3]Logbook[/h3]
Players will be able to unlock and view items in a logbook from the main menu. The logbook will include descriptions of each of the Bots, the Robofriends, every enemy, and the upgrades. Players can immerse in the lore and read the unlocked comic book pages in the logbook. 

[h3]Party-wide upgrades for Arcade Mode[/h3] 
New upgrades that will affect all players will be added to Arcade Mode. Upgrades will do a variety of different things, such as enemies dropping HP orbs. 

[h3]A large variety of Arcade Mode rooms layouts[/h3]
More Arcade Mode rooms, outfitted with different enemy patterns and paths. 

[h3]A variety of improvements and fixes[/h3]
Updates to sound effects, particle effects, balancing, and more!

We will be posting update announcements on our twitter, twitter.com/game_grotto as well as streaming our beta testing on our twitch, twitch.tv/game_grotto. We hope you look forward to these new features, and keep an eye out for our updates and patch note announcements!

Game Grotto Softworks Team -
www.gamegrottosoftworks.com
